claims: Upward Bound is a federally funded TRIO program.
Upward Bound provides free college preparatory support to high school students from low-income backgrounds.
Upward Bound provides free college preparatory support to high school students from families where parents did not complete a bachelor's degree.
Upward Bound provides tutoring.
Upward Bound provides mentoring.
Upward Bound provides career counseling.
Upward Bound provides summer residential programs.
Upward Bound targets high school students typically in 9-12th grade.
Upward Bound targets potential first-generation college students.
Upward Bound targets students who meet low-income criteria.
Upward Bound provides free tutoring.
Upward Bound provides SAT/ACT prep.
Upward Bound provides academic advising.
Upward Bound provides college application assistance.
Upward Bound provides financial aid (FAFSA) guidance.
Upward Bound provides cultural field trips.
Upward Bound operates year-round.
Upward Bound has after-school sessions during the academic year.
Upward Bound has a 6-week intensive summer program.
Upward Bound's summer program is often held on college campuses.
Upward Bound's goal is to increase the rates at which participants enroll in and graduate from institutions of postsecondary education.
Upward Bound programs include standard Upward Bound.
Upward Bound programs include Upward Bound Math & Science (UBMS).
Upward Bound programs include Veterans Upward Bound.
Upward Bound is funded by the U.S. Department of Education.
Upward Bound has been in operation since the 1960s.
Upward Bound is part of the War on Poverty programs.
